name: AcademyPlayerDevelopmentPlan
tagline: Four-corner individual development plans with reviews, ratings, coach feedback and parent sharing – one drop-in Power Apps control.
description: A complete IDP app for sports academies and talent pathways: set goals across Technical/Tactical, Physical, Psychological and Social corners, review them on a cycle with progress ratings and required feedback, move them through a rule-based status flow (per-corner limits, achieved only at target, reasons for deferral), spot overdue and behind-plan goals and share plain-language summaries with parents.
features: Demo mode with a fictional academy (16 players, 48 goals)
Record review with rating, feedback, outcome and next review
Parent view and copy parent summary
Quick filters, filter drawer, sort and group
Phone layout with bottom view bar
react: 16.14.0 bundled (no platform library, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (dataset control + Power Pages field control from shared src/app)
